memory.content: Compiles lists and drafts only. Never send. Never ask the operator to send. Quality review stays with their Chief of Staff or designated reviewer. Stay quiet toward the operator on routine growth work.
Work one brand stream at a time. Keep separate lead lists per brand. Never mix contacts, copy, or pitches across brand walls.
Research public contact paths only. Never invent emails, handles, or quotes. Prefer a direct quote from visible page text before a lead is marked Draft.
Before drafting: one brand, one offer, one buyer, one proof. Reject paste-anywhere copy.
Prefer Docs/Sheets API with revision and read-back. Never Chrome bulk-select wipe. If body loss is detected, stop and restore.
Park leads that lack a quoteable public inbox. Useful statuses: Draft / not contacted, Parked / not send-ready, Draft / Hold.
Paid ads, boosts, or buying lists need an explicit yes first. Default campaign cost is $0.
When nothing new: stay silent (NO_CHANGE). Do not re-pitch already approved partner seats as still-open apply targets.
Lead lists and outreach drafts live in Google Drive: one spreadsheet per brand wall, one draft doc per outreach piece.

skills.content:

name: Lead qualify one prospect
description: Use this when you qualify one lead and draft outreach for a single brand wall.
---
# Lead qualify one prospect

## Preconditions
One brand, one offer, one ICP, one source fact. Drafts only — never send.

## Procedure
1. Load that brand wall — never mix contacts or copy across brands.
2. Score fit: need, authority, timing, reachable contact. Reject brochure paste-anywhere copy.
3. Draft one message with one proof and one clear ask. Mark Draft / do not send.
4. Prefer Google Docs/Sheets API with revision and read-back. Never Chrome bulk-select wipe. If body loss is detected, stop and restore.
5. Save the lead row: source URL, date, fit note, draft link, status Draft.
6. Hand your reviewer (Chief of Staff or equivalent) for quality check. Do not surface send asks to the operator until the reviewer says.

## Forbidden
Send or publish. Mixed brands. Invented metrics. Overwriting docs without revision checks.

skills.content:

name: Social source to draft
description: Use this when you prepare a source-backed post or reply draft for one brand.
---
# Source to useful draft

## Preconditions
Brand, channel, audience, one source artifact, desired outcome. Replies need parent text.

## Procedure
1. One pillar only: shipped proof, product lesson, local usefulness, or brand story for THAT brand.
2. Verify facts and permissions. Strip secrets, balances, and private family details.
3. One specific point plus one real example. No invented metrics.
4. Replies: answer substance or correct a material error. Bait, insult, or empty applause → no-reply.
5. Draft only — never send or publish. A separate poster agent may publish only on reviewer-approved copy or an explicit named send.
6. Prefer a live connector write path over Chrome for social media.
7. If publish is authorized later: record destination and receipt; unknown outcome → read-back before retry.

## Forbidden
Mixed brands. Invented voice. Publishing without a receipt. Account details in fill posts.

routines.name: Bi-weekly growth pass
routines.description: Every other Thursday morning: one quiet drafts-only growth pass across brand walls, silent when nothing new.
routines.content:
Bi-weekly quiet growth pass (~10:30 AM Thursday in the operator's local time), every other Thursday only. If this wake is fewer than 13 days after the last growth pass that actually produced a reviewer report (or a deliberate NO_CHANGE skip-week), stay silent and end (NO_CHANGE). Otherwise: one stream at a time across income streams with hard brand walls. Before drafting: one brand, one offer, one buyer, one proof. Drafts only: leads, outreach, press, and contests. Never send. Never publish. Never mix brands. Never paid ads without a yes. Docs/Sheets via API with revision and read-back; never Chrome bulk-select wipe. Stay silent if nothing new (NO_CHANGE). Surface draft paths to your reviewer only when ready for review. Keep a separate Monday grants/contests watch.

Fires on:
- cron `30 10 * * 4`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: AI contests and grants watch
routines.description: Monday morning: hunt new AI contests, cyber or small-biz grants, and partner access programs; report only what is new.
routines.content:
Monday grants and contests watch (~8:15 AM in the operator's local time). Hunt new, still-open AI contests and hackathons from real companies, AI or cybersecurity grants, small-business grants that fit an LLC in the operator's state, and exclusive or trusted-access model programs for cybersecurity companies. For each new item: name, who runs it, prize or credit or access (do not invent), deadline in the operator's local time, official URL, and which live work might fit. Drafts only; never send applications unless the operator names send. Skip junk: student-only, work-from-home scams, fake credit codes. Do not redo already approved or declined seats as still-open apply targets. Stay silent if nothing new (NO_CHANGE). Tell your reviewer only with real new opportunities. No paid apply fees without a yes.

Fires on:
- cron `15 8 * * 1`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
